periods.time: Final day and aftermath of Seven Stars
periods.label: 支援一辉的黑蔷薇

status.current: helps Ikki warm up and later teases the couple's morning-after secret

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Close friend; spars with him first to test his body after a day asleep.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Close companion; leaves the infirmary with her after Ikki wakes.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Friend; notices the atmosphere after Stella and Ikki's first night.

periods.summary: Alice opens Ikki's final-day adjustment with shadow beasts and shadow movement, confirming that Ikki's body has not dulled after sleep. He watches the final with Shizuku and other allies, helps care for Ikki and Stella in the infirmary, and the next morning immediately notices what happened between them. His teasing exposes the secret but he declines to stop Shizuku's angry reaction.

key_events.summary: Spars first with Ikki using Shadow Beast Play and shadow movement.
Leaves Ikki and Stella alone after confirming Ikki has awakened.
Notices the couple's changed atmosphere and teases them.

abilities: Shadow Walk / Light and Shadow Passage

periods.time: Ikki's victory party and start of summer break
periods.label: 返乡扫墓

status.current: plans to return home during summer to visit a friend's grave
status.condition: supportive of Shizuku but unable to accompany her to Hiroshima

relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Close friend; he understands her desire to learn from Kiriko and wishes her success.

periods.summary: At the post-tournament party, Nagi notices Shizuku's unease and talks with her about her desire to study under Kiriko after failing to help Ikki during his near death. When Shizuku asks whether he can accompany her to Hiroshima, Nagi apologizes because he wants to use summer break to return home and visit the grave of a friend he has neglected.

key_events.summary: Supports Shizuku emotionally and reveals his own summer plan.

periods.label: 以后方支援守护避难者

status.current: safe after supporting evacuees and reunited with Shizuku

relationships.kurono-shinguji: Meets her while guiding lost children in the evacuation zone.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Close friend; reunites with her after she returns from Vermillion.
relationships.kagami-kusakabe: Walks with her during the victory-night reporting.

periods.summary: Alice returns from visiting his old friends' graves and supports Tokyo's rear line rather than fighting at the front, using shadow movement to transport lost children and supplies through the crowded evacuation zone. After the US retreat he walks with Kagami through the celebrations, comments on the importance of Kurono's delayed interview, and warmly reunites with Shizuku, discussing both his grave visit and her success in saving Ikki this time.

key_events.summary: Guides lost children to their parents during the evacuation.
Reunites with Shizuku and shares the victory celebration with Kagami.

periods.label: 黑蔷薇的侦查与影中支援

status.condition: leg broken and later burned/injured but survives

personality.summary: Alice understands fortress assaults and volunteers because his shadow abilities can bypass precisely the kind of prepared facility Eilands likely uses. Even after injury, he prioritizes the mission and urges Ikki and Shizuku onward.
values: using former assassin skills for rescue
flaws: physically less suited to the high-speed combatants around him
becomes a mobility liability after the ambush

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Friend whose shadow carries Alice during the rush to Nikko; Alice scouts the path for him.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Friend who relies on his route-finding and later acts on his warning that delay would doom Stella.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Friend/rescue target; he volunteers specifically to help reach her before the fortress delay becomes fatal.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Ouma protects him and tells him to focus on self-preservation during the Abraham fight.
relationships.toka-todo: Touka takes injury while protecting him from Abraham's surprise attack.

periods.summary: Alice volunteers for the rescue because Eilands' facilities are likely fortified and his shadow abilities can bypass maze-like defenses. He travels in Ikki's shadow, uses Shadow Beast Pictograph to send shadow-mice through vents, locates Stella's tank and maps the route. He also saves the team from Large EDY cannon fire with Shadow Walk. On the fourth floor he is injured by Abraham's surprise attack, but uses Shadow Bind to restrain the clones long enough for Ikki and Shizuku to continue. After the possessed Stella blast, he survives because Ouma uses wind armor to protect him and Touka.

key_events.summary: Volunteers to join the rescue as a shadow infiltration specialist.
Maps the hidden laboratory route and evacuates the team from EDY cannon fire by Shadow Walk.
Uses Shadow Bind despite a broken leg to let Ikki and Shizuku advance.
